_note: Edit the install guide here without touching code. Every text has 'en' and 'tl'. 'command' (optional) shows a Copy button. 'screenshot' is a file in assets/ or empty for a placeholder. 'choose_help: true' puts the 'Not sure? Read this' box in that step. The LAN/Online choice lives ONLY inside the installer (it writes SMARTSCHOOL_MODE) – never ask it on the website before download.

items.en: A Windows 10 or 11 computer that can stay on during school hours. 4 GB memory is enough.
items.tl: Isang Windows 10 o 11 na computer na puwedeng nakabukas buong oras ng klase. Sapat na ang 4 GB na memory.

items.en: The school Wi-Fi router, if teachers will use their own phones or laptops.
items.tl: Ang Wi-Fi router ng paaralan, kung gagamit ang mga guro ng sarili nilang cellphone o laptop.

items.en: Internet only for downloading. After that, it can work offline.
items.tl: Internet para lang sa pag-download. Pagkatapos noon, puwede na itong gumana kahit offline.

items.en: The name of your school and the current school year.
items.tl: Ang pangalan ng paaralan ninyo at ang kasalukuyang school year.

items.en: The school Wi-Fi set to “Private network” on the main computer and on every Windows computer that will use SmartSchool.
items.tl: Naka-“Private network” ang Wi-Fi ng paaralan sa main computer at sa bawat Windows computer na gagamit ng SmartSchool.

text.en: If a blue “Windows protected your PC” box appears, click “More info”, then “Run anyway”.
text.tl: Kapag may lumabas na asul na “Windows protected your PC”, i-click ang “More info”, tapos “Run anyway”.

title.en: In the installer, pick how your school will use it
title.tl: Sa installer, piliin kung paano ito gagamitin ng paaralan

text.en: “Offline on school Wi-Fi (LAN)” – recommended for most schools. “Online (web host)” – for parent and student accounts.
text.tl: “Offline sa Wi-Fi ng paaralan (LAN)” – inirerekomenda para sa karamihan ng paaralan. “Online (web host)” – para sa account ng mga magulang at estudyante.

text.en: The installer does the rest: it checks the computer, prepares the database and starts SmartSchool. If it says the network is Public, click “Yes” to make it Private – other devices can't connect on a Public network.
text.tl: Ang installer na ang bahala sa iba: tinitingnan nito ang computer, inihahanda ang database at sinisimulan ang SmartSchool. Kapag sinabi nitong Public ang network, i-click ang “Yes” para gawing Private – hindi makakakonekta ang ibang device sa Public na network.

title.tl: Buksan ang SmartSchool sa ibang device

text.en: Type the address it shows (like http://192.168.1.10:8000) in a browser on the same Wi-Fi. On every Windows computer that will use SmartSchool, set that Wi-Fi to Private: Settings › Network & internet › Wi-Fi › your network › Private network.
text.tl: I-type ang address na ipinapakita nito (gaya ng http://192.168.1.10:8000) sa browser na nasa parehong Wi-Fi. Sa bawat Windows computer na gagamit ng SmartSchool, gawing Private ang Wi-Fi na iyon: Settings › Network & internet › Wi-Fi › ang network ninyo › Private network.

title.en: Create the Superadmin and finish setup
title.tl: Gawin ang Superadmin at tapusin ang setup

text.en: Enter your name, email and a strong password, then answer the short setup questions. Write the Superadmin email and password down and keep them safe – this account can't be recovered by anyone else.
text.tl: Ilagay ang pangalan mo, email at isang matibay na password, tapos sagutin ang maikling setup. Isulat ang email at password ng Superadmin at itago nang maayos – walang ibang makakabawi ng account na ito.

good.en: Schools with slow or no internet
good.tl: Mga paaralang mabagal o walang internet
Mabilis i-set up sa isang computer

keep.en: No student or parent accounts – staff register students
keep.tl: Walang account ang estudyante at magulang – staff ang nagre-register

keep.en: Works only inside the school network
keep.tl: Gumagana lang sa loob ng network ng paaralan
Sa mga guro napupunta ang mga paalala

good.tl: May account ang mga magulang at estudyante

good.en: Grades and alerts on phones at home
good.tl: Grades at alerto sa cellphone kahit nasa bahay

keep.en: Needs a web host and a domain
keep.tl: Kailangan ng web host at domain

text.en: Pick the size that fits your school in the “Hosting & database” table. A VPS with Ubuntu 24.04 is the easiest – the installer sets everything up on it.
text.tl: Piliin ang laki na bagay sa paaralan ninyo sa table na “Hosting at database”. Pinakamadali ang VPS na may Ubuntu 24.04 – ang installer na ang mag-aayos ng lahat.

title.en: Point your domain to the server

text.en: In your domain's DNS settings, add an “A record” for your website name (for example school.example.edu.ph) with the server's IP address. It can take up to an hour to work.
text.tl: Sa DNS settings ng domain, magdagdag ng “A record” para sa pangalan ng website (halimbawa school.example.edu.ph) gamit ang IP address ng server. Puwedeng umabot ng isang oras bago gumana.

text.en: Open the Terminal (Windows: PowerShell) and log in with the IP and password your hosting company gave you:
text.tl: Buksan ang Terminal (Windows: PowerShell) at mag-log in gamit ang IP at password na ibinigay ng hosting company:

text.en: Paste this and press Enter. Choose “2) Online”, then “1) A fresh server I control”, and type your domain and email. It installs the database, the website and free HTTPS automatically.
text.tl: I-paste ito at pindutin ang Enter. Piliin ang “2) Online”, tapos “1) A fresh server I control”, at i-type ang domain at email. Awtomatiko nitong ini-install ang database, website at libreng HTTPS.

text.en: Go to https://your-domain, create the Superadmin and follow the setup pop-up. Using shared hosting instead? Choose “2) Shared hosting” in the installer, then set the document root to ~/smartschool/public and add the cron job it shows.
text.tl: Pumunta sa https://your-domain, gawin ang Superadmin at sundin ang setup pop-up. Shared hosting ang gamit? Piliin ang “2) Shared hosting” sa installer, tapos gawing ~/smartschool/public ang document root at idagdag ang cron job na ipinapakita nito.

q.en: Other devices can't open the address
q.tl: Hindi mabuksan ng ibang device ang address

a.en: Check that the Wi-Fi is set to Private on the main computer (Settings › Network & internet › Wi-Fi › your network › Private network) – a Public network blocks other devices. Also make sure they are on the same Wi-Fi and that you typed the full address including the number after the colon (for example :8000).
a.tl: Tingnan kung Private ang Wi-Fi sa main computer (Settings › Network & internet › Wi-Fi › ang network ninyo › Private network) – hinaharangan ng Public na network ang ibang device. Siguraduhin ding nasa parehong Wi-Fi sila at kumpleto ang na-type mong address kasama ang numero pagkatapos ng colon (halimbawa :8000).

q.en: Windows says the app might be unsafe
q.tl: Sinasabi ng Windows na baka hindi ligtas ang app

a.en: This appears for new apps that aren't widely downloaded yet. Check the checksum in the Download section, then click “More info” and “Run anyway”.
a.tl: Lumalabas ito sa mga bagong app na hindi pa gaanong nada-download. I-check ang checksum sa Download section, tapos i-click ang “More info” at “Run anyway”.

q.en: The address changed after restarting the router
q.tl: Nagbago ang address pagkatapos i-restart ang router

a.en: The installer's window always shows the current address. To keep it the same, ask your IT person to give the main computer a fixed (reserved) IP address in the router.
a.tl: Laging ipinapakita ng installer ang kasalukuyang address. Para hindi na magbago, ipa-set sa IT person ang fixed (reserved) IP address para sa main computer sa router.

a.en: The Superadmin can change it later in Settings. A backup is made first.
a.tl: Puwede itong palitan ng Superadmin sa Settings. May backup na gagawin muna.

a.en: Teachers and staff: ask your Superadmin to reset it. The Superadmin account itself is critical – nobody can recover it, so keep its email and password written down somewhere safe.
a.tl: Mga guro at staff: ipa-reset sa Superadmin ninyo. Napakahalaga ng mismong Superadmin account – walang makakabawi nito, kaya isulat at itago nang ligtas ang email at password nito.
